metadata.description: Small, practical Claude Code plugins from a home workshop: hand sketching and safety rules for hardware work.

plugins.name: drawing-board
plugins.description: Sketch an idea by hand and let Claude look at it: a Windows pen window that opens with a keyboard shortcut (with a regular tablet the whole tablet draws), or an offline browser board on any system.

plugins.name: safe-device-work
plugins.description: Guardrails for Claude when it works on real disks, USB sticks, NAS/RAID, microcontroller flash, admin sessions and accounts.
